tools.name: suggest_meetup
tools.description: Submit a missing meetup for human review before publication. Dates and times use Asia/Jerusalem, from yesterday through two years ahead. Provide city or online=true. Shared suggestion rate limits apply.

tools.name: suggest_source
tools.description: Submit a calendar or community URL for human review before publication. Shared suggestion rate limits apply.

tools.name: list_upcoming_meetups
tools.description: Upcoming tech meetups in Israel, soonest first. In-person by default; mode=online for online sessions. Use when=week for "what's on this week".

tools.name: search_meetups
tools.description: Search upcoming meetups. Combine any of: free text (title, topic, organizer, venue; Hebrew or English, every word must match), a topic tag, a date range, a time window, mode (in-person by default) and exclude_paid. Tags: ai (AI וסוכנים), startups (יזמות וסטארטאפים), makers (דיפטק וחומרה), data (דאטה

tools.name: get_meetup
tools.description: Full details of one meetup by id (ids come from the list and search tools).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Topic tags with how many upcoming in-person meetups each has, plus the number of online sessions. Pass a tag id to search_meetups.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The public calendars, Meetup groups, Luma pages, conferences, venues and company event pages the list is updated from daily. Filter by kind or free text (name or topic).
